name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v2.1.7 — Parity gate with corp full-rebuild lineage (2026-05-25). 8 UX/CSS fixes consolidated from corp v2.1.1→v2.1.7: defensive `--surface-hover` token in light/dark/media blocks (Bug A), Ring CSS-module selectors replaced with `.td-*` + explicit widths (Bug C), textarea defensive `min-height:72px` on multiline input-hosts (Bug D), modal click-anchor fix to ignore clicks inside open modals (Bug #1 — fixes pagination jump + textarea collapse in confirmGoal flow), Ring font-size 13px scoped override (Bug #3), table column-widths min/max balance + table min-width 600→1100px (Bug #4), table inputs font-size:13px (polish), dateStart/dateEnd column min/max-width with `td-date td-start|end` className (polish). No schema changes. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
